name: py-hover-body
description: Show the full function implementation in the hover tooltip, without jumping to the definition

pyHoverBody.enabled.description: Show function implementations (full body) in the hover tooltip

pyHoverBody.maxLines.description: Maximum number of body lines to show (long functions get truncated)

pyHoverBody.delayMs.description: Delay before returning the implementation so it appears below the default Pylance hover (0 disables the delay)
